On this page What changed Review verdict

What changed

The branch removes exactly one comment above COLD_START_BACKLOG_SECS:

-// DONT DECLARE A NEW var here, i think this wont be needed after we update the lowerbound comment i made below
 // Extra backlog for the cold-start epoch sweep, so a restart still picks up
 // claims that were pending L2 finalization when the bot went down.
 const COLD_START_BACKLOG_SECS = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60;

The deleted text was an informal implementation note that no longer matched the file: the constant is already declared, and the adjacent two-line comment explains its current purpose. Git reports 1 file changed, 1 deletion.

Review verdict

Safe to accept. The diff is documentation-only and precisely matches F6. No executable token or behavior changed, so no runtime regression is introduced by this patch.
